title: End-to-End Fix: Households & Shopping List Sync + OpenAPI Alignment
acceptance_criteria: Implement GET /api/v1/households in backend returning the households the authenticated user belongs to (with member roles).
ShoppingListView fetches current list from GET /api/v1/households/{id}/shopping-list and removes mock SEED_SHOPPING_LIST.
Offline queue stores pending changes locally when offline; when toggled online, triggers POST /api/v1/households/{id}/shopping-list/sync with Last-Write-Wins timestamps.
Updating or checking off a shopping list item synchronizes with real DB table shopping_list_items.
Verify and update docs/Ediens_OpenAPI.yaml so 100% of routes, request schemas, and RFC 9457 responses match the final .NET API implementation.
